subject: Acme Fintech - Procurement & Vendor Onboarding follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acme-fintech.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Fintech - Procurement & Vendor Onboarding follow-up

Hi Lisa / Raj —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: Acme wants to deploy Redwood Private for production inference in east-coast US region for customer support and transaction monitoring workflows.
- Primary decision criteria: latency < 200ms P95, data isolation, SOC2 audit evidence, predictable monthly committed spend.
- Key stakeholders:
  - Lisa Chang (Director, Product) — product requirements and decision criteria
  - Raj Patel (Head of Procurement) — procurement, PO, vendor setup
  - Legal/Security — security questionnaire & DPA review (we understand this is Kiran + Legal)
  - Engineering (SRE) — will run the pilot and validate perf metrics

Open items / asks for Acme:
1) Confirm economic buyer and final approval owner (title/name).
2) Procurement: vendor onboarding form + any vendor-specific tax/PO requirements.
3) Timeline: target go-live for pilot and when procurement expects PO issuance.
4) Security: point-of-contact for SOC2 evidence and encryption / key management questions.

What we (Redwood) will do next:
- Share vendor onboarding form + standard SOW draft (attached).
- Provide estimated TCO and a pilot roll plan with milestone dates.
- Provide contact for security questionnaire and SOC2 artifacts.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (vendor questionnaire), SOW_draft_v1.docx

Proposed next step: If you can confirm procurement next steps and the economic buyer, we’ll send the formal vendor paperwork and can schedule a short 30-min alignment with procurement this week.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-fintech.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acme Fintech - Procurement & Vendor Onboarding follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 
- Economic buyer: Michael Huang, VP Finance (michael.huang@acme-fintech.com). He will sign off on committed spend.
- Procurement owner: Raj Patel (cc’d) will drive vendor setup and PO.
- Security/legal POC: Kiran Mehta (kiran.mehta@acme-fintech.com) will handle SOC2/DPA and technical security questions.
- Timeline: We’re aiming for a pilot start in mid-November. Procurement has a standard 3-week vendor onboarding window once we receive your vendor form + W-9.

Raj — can you confirm if Acme requires any specific vendor fields beyond the attached vendor form? We typically need a completed vendor questionnaire + Acme_Vendor_Form.xlsx (I can upload the template).

Also, curious about the invoicing cadence for Dedicated: do you support monthly invoices against committed spend or do you require upfront payment?

Best,
Lisa
Director, Product — Acme Fintech

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-fintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Connor OBrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acme Fintech - Procurement & Vendor Onboarding follow-up

Thanks Lisa — looping in procurement details.

Marissa / Connor —
A few procurement notes and requests from our side: 
1) Please complete the attached Acme_Vendor_Form.xlsx and return with your company W-9 and standard invoice remittance details.
2) Vendor setup SLA: ~10 business days once complete packet received. We route contracts to Legal after vendor setup for review (Legal turnaround ~7 business days).
3) PO process: we issue monthly POs against a subscription commitment. Net 30 payment terms standard.
4) Tax/EIN info required on the vendor form.
5) For SOC2 / security evidence: we need a copy of your latest SOC2 Type II report and a contact for security reviews. Redacted reports are acceptable.

Attachments: [Attachment: Acme_Vendor_Form.xlsx (xlsx)]

If you can send the completed package by Friday (10/09) we can aim to have vendor setup complete and a PO in mid-November for your pilot.

Regards,
Raj Patel
Head of Procurement — Acme Fintech

- Connor / David will join the procurement call if you’d like to schedule one — we’re free Friday 10/09 between 10–12 PT or Monday 10/12 after 1pm PT.
